measurement_scope: One fresh packed request: encode/embed both slot vectors; two fresh public encryptions; ct*ct tensor/relinearize; ciphertext square/relinearize; p-corrected drop L0->L1; encrypted row-left rotation; actual Alice-to-Bob key switch; second p-corrected drop L1->L2; Bob exact full-N recovery, subring extract and all256-slot decode. Complete online RNG, transforms, decomposition/residual and exact quotient work included. Tables/context/two secret clients/PK/three evaluation keys/prepared operators/buffers and independent expected-slot oracle are outside timing. Every output slot and off-subring zero is asserted after each process workload; the same artifacts pass real --test smoke before timing.

equivalent_control.scope: Step09 frozen executable versus current source workflow with only explicit level-0 API arguments changed; inspect workflow-source-diff.patch. Equivalent complete request, ABBA old/new/new/old.

memory_smoke.scope: /usr/bin/time measures its direct taskset->benchmark child after an exec boundary, excluding the Python parent pre-exec RSS floor. Correctness --test smoke includes complete context/key/operator setup, persistent storage and one complete request plus output assertions; it excludes Criterion timed sampling/statistical analysis. Neither number is incremental request allocation.

raw_wait4_rss_interpretation: All six Python-spawn wait4 observations were29184KiB. This lifetime peak includes the inherited Python pre-exec RSS floor, so it is not an isolated Rust benchmark peak. The separate /usr/bin/time -v correctness smoke measures the exec-isolated taskset->benchmark child; that smoke includes complete setup and one request but excludes Criterion timed sampling/statistical analysis. Neither RSS measurement is per-request allocation.
data_format: Original Criterion samples/estimates retained per process; derived CSV divides original elapsed nanoseconds by iterations.
comparison: New capability; two independent process runs report absolute costs, no equivalent prior implementation or speedup claim.
limits: Functional diagnostic parameters do not certify security or full evaluated noise admission. In-process confidence intervals do not cover process/machine variation. The equivalent-control averages differ by about0.04%, with no substantive speedup/regression claim.
